jobs.name: bi-daily-hermes-update
jobs.prompt:
Run `hermes update` to update Hermes Agent to the latest version. After the update completes, restart the dashboard and verify all services are working. Then send a Telegram message summarizing the update status.

IMPORTANT — follow this exact sequence:
1. `systemctl stop hermes-dashboard` — stop dashboard cleanly BEFORE the update so no stale process holds port 9119
2. `hermes update` — run the full update
3. `systemctl start hermes-dashboard` — restart the dashboard after update
4. Verify: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:9119/` must return 200
5. Verify: `systemctl status hermes-gateway --no-pager` — gateway must be active (running)
6. Verify: nginx is routing correctly — `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://dashboard.terrybot.top/` must return 401 (Basic Auth challenge = nginx proxy working)

Send the final status report to Telegram including:
- Whether update succeeded or failed
- Dashboard HTTP status (200 = good)
- Gateway status (active/running or not)
- Nginx proxy status (401 = good, anything else = problem)
